title: Mount Ashomel
summary: A vertical climb up a living volcano: four tall streets of dark, warm basalt ledges zigzagging up past steam vents, lava falls and squirting lava vents, to a crater rim over a glowing lava lake. Ash haze above, an orange glow from below. Friendly and storybook, never grim: a place to climb, not a disaster.
light: Soft daylight from the upper left lights the tops of rocks; a warm orange lava glow comes up from below and from cracks, rimming the undersides and the right-hand edges.
texture: Painted, slightly mottled rock with rounded chunky forms; cracks and seams glow; pumice is pale and pitted.

gz_ai_ash_haze_sky.what: A wide, soft band of volcanic ash haze for the far sky: smoky violet ash above that turns into a warm orange glow along the bottom, as if lit by lava below the horizon. Very soft, no shapes at all, fading out to nothing at the left, right and top edges.

gz_ai_ash_cloud_big.what: A big, puffy ash cloud: rounded lumps, pale grey-violet on top, lit warm orange from underneath.

gz_ai_ash_cloud_small.what: A small ash cloud, the same look as a big one: a few rounded puffs, pale on top, orange-lit underneath.

gz_ai_volcano_cone_far.what: The distant volcano seen far away: a broad cone with a glowing orange mouth at its top and a soft ash plume rising from it. Hazy and low-contrast, as far scenery is, with its base running straight along the bottom of the picture.

gz_ai_basalt_ridge.what: A long row of dark basalt hills and crags far behind the climb, for a background layer: broad, simple rounded shapes, softened by a warm ash haze, with little detail and no glowing seams. Solid rock from the bottom of the picture up to an uneven skyline of rounded peaks; nothing at all above the skyline (that part is background).

gz_ai_basalt_slope_tall.what: A tall flank of the volcano rising to the right, far behind the climb: dark basalt stepping up in a few broad rounded shelves, softened by haze, plain and quiet with little detail, solid to the bottom and the right edge, open sky to the upper left.

gz_ai_basalt_columns.what: A cluster of six-sided basalt columns of different heights standing together, flat tops lit from above, warm dark rock.

gz_ai_basalt_ledge_small.what: A small rock ledge a character walks on: a thick shelf of warm dark basalt with a nearly flat top face, a lighter top edge, a short, gently uneven underside and one thin glowing lava crack in its face.

gz_ai_basalt_ledge_medium.what: A medium rock ledge a character walks on: a thick shelf of warm dark basalt with a nearly flat top face, a lighter top edge, a short, gently uneven underside and two thin glowing lava cracks in its face.

gz_ai_basalt_ledge_large.what: A long rock ledge a character walks on: a wide, thick shelf of warm dark basalt with a nearly flat top face, a lighter top edge, a short, gently uneven underside and three thin glowing lava cracks in its face.

gz_ai_pumice_ledge_small.what: A small ledge a character walks on: a pale, pitted pumice cap (cream and sand colours full of little holes) on a thick shelf of dark rock, nearly flat on top, with a short, gently uneven underside.

gz_ai_pumice_ledge_large.what: A long ledge a character walks on: a pale, pitted pumice cap on a thick shelf of dark rock, nearly flat on top, a short, gently uneven underside and one thin glowing crack in its face.

gz_ai_basalt_ground.what: The ground at the foot of the volcano: a strip of dark basalt with a nearly flat walkable top, a slightly lighter top edge with a few pebbles, and layered, solid rock below it all the way down, with one or two faint warm cracks.

gz_ai_basalt_support.what: A pillar of six-sided basalt columns packed together, the rock a low ledge stands on: warm dark basalt, the column edges catching a little light, one faint warm crack.

gz_ai_basalt_wall.what: A tall basalt cliff face that the high ledges jut out of: warm dark rock in broad vertical columns and planes, a few cracks, one faint glowing seam.

gz_ai_lava_pool.what: A shallow glowing lava pool seen from the side, in a low rim of crusted dark rock: bright yellow-orange in the middle, deep red at the edges, a few dark crust plates floating on it.

gz_ai_lava_fall.what: A lava fall: a plain narrow stream of glowing lava falling straight down, bright yellow-orange in its middle, deep red at its edges, with a few darker streaks running down it.

gz_ai_lava_fall_lip.what: The rock lip a lava fall pours from: a short, chunky spout of dark basalt jutting out to the front, glowing orange in its mouth, with the top of the lava stream just leaving it (the fall itself is a separate piece).

gz_ai_steam_vent.what: A steam vent: a squat little cone of dark rock with a dark open mouth at the top, crusted with pale yellow sulphur around the mouth. No steam (the game adds the steam).

gz_ai_lava_vent.what: A lava vent: a squat cone of dark rock with a glowing orange mouth at the top and a little lava running down one side. No flying lava (the game adds the squirts).

gz_ai_cooled_rock_1.what: A big boulder of cooled lava with ropey, folded, wrinkled surface, warm dark basalt colours.

gz_ai_cooled_rock_2.what: A small rock of cooled lava, rounded, with a few ropey folds, warm dark basalt colours.

gz_ai_cooled_rock_hot.what: A boulder still hot inside: dark cooled crust broken by glowing orange and yellow cracks.

gz_ai_crater_rim.what: The volcano's crater seen from its edge: a far crater wall of dark rock with glowing seams at the back, a glowing lava lake in the middle, and the near lip of the crater in front as a broad, nearly flat walkable rock edge across the middle of the picture; both ends rise into rock.
gz_ai_crater_rim.notes: The near lip is walked on: keep its top flat across the middle three quarters of the width.

gz_ai_steam_puff_1.what: One soft, round puff of white steam, slightly grey at its shaded lower right, soft edges.

gz_ai_steam_puff_2.what: One small soft puff of white steam, soft edges.

gz_ai_steam_wisp.what: One curling wisp of white steam, soft edges, as tall as it is wide, thinning to nothing at its top.

gz_ai_lava_blob.what: One round glowing blob of lava: yellow-white hot centre, orange, then a deep red edge with a soft glow.

gz_ai_lava_drop.what: One glowing lava droplet shaped like a teardrop with its point upward: yellow-white centre, orange, deep red edge.

gz_ai_ember.what: One tiny glowing ember spark: a bright yellow-orange dot with a soft glow round it.
